policy_owner: existing production durable/native owner; this file is not an executable authorizer
principle: Development task completion is not activation evidence. Evaluate current receipts for exact target, effect, adapter version and scope at effect time.

gates.evidence: Local keyboard/UI STOP blocks new effects without ASR; ongoing remote work is shown unknown until observed cancellation.
Previously authorized actor/effect/recipient/data/repo/time/budget scope still covers this operation; prompt contents cannot issue a grant.
invalidated_by: new effect or target outside scope

gates.evidence: Current account/workspace/conversation or device/action target matches binding revision immediately before the external effect.
Immutable packet digest and actual transmitted projection match permitted data categories and target; remote upload is an external effect before Send.
Relevant acceptance and failure fixtures passed for this effect on this adapter/device/target class; no generic all-PC qualification.
Owner lease/fencing, durable pre-effect intent and post-effect evidence are available; unknown outcome cannot cause blind resend.
One controller owns desktop foreground/input/clipboard resources for the required operation, across all chats.
Specific source version/build artifact/digest link and required checks are independently observed.
Chosen device, package format and current configuration meet installation prerequisites; staged test profile is recorded.
Previous artifact and data recovery path are verified; irreversible migration blocks automatic installation until a separate scoped plan exists.
Actual installed action binding and observable postcondition were verified for current code/config; AI claims and merge receipts are insufficient.

bounded_qualification_session.purpose: Collect real adapter evidence using explicitly scoped qualification fixtures; full qualification cannot be a prerequisite for collecting itself.
additional_requirements: bounded fixture/test recipient and effect list
foreground_resource_owned if UI uses shared desktop
record NOT_PASSED until actual case evidence exists
unknown or unregistered effects remain disabled

not_implied: The user has granted any new live external effect in this strategy-only task.
A passed development DAG node is a runtime receipt.
Planner projection holds locks or executes jobs.
A user implementation assertion proves merge or installation.
